Ticket 2 — "Invoice PDF has the wrong date" — status: open. That title is all it says; it has no description or details yet (no version, order id, or example of the wrong vs. expected date). I added the note "looking at it" to it.

I left the ticket open and did not delete it. Also worth knowing: there is no invoice/PDF code in this project (only cart.py, cli.py, pricing.py, report.py and tests/), so the report can't be checked against the code here as things stand.
